incident: A clean recovery PR could not reach terminal closure because its Supersedes predecessor was intentionally closed unmerged.
root_cause: The migration lineage walker treated every unmerged predecessor as unsafe, even when same-obligation and migration-free.
prevention_rule: Closed-unmerged same-obligation predecessors may be traversed only when GitHub file readback proves they contain no active supabase/migrations/*.sql. Open, cross-obligation, or migration-bearing unmerged predecessors remain fail-closed.
